summary: Nvidia earnings and Anthropic IPO are near-term major catalysts ('big cards to turn over') for the AI investment thesis
summary_extended: Baker identifies two imminent market events — Nvidia's earnings report (that evening) and the Anthropic IPO (the following day) — as major near-term catalysts that will materially shape investor sentiment on the AI investment thesis. He frames these as 'big cards to turn over,' suggesting the outcomes will provide concrete data points rather than speculation. Nvidia's results are expected to inform the market's view on AI datacenter capex trajectory and hyperscaler demand durability, while the Anthropic IPO will serve as a real-world test of AI model monetization and investor appetite for AI software businesses. Baker does not offer a directional call on either outcome, presenting this as a forward-looking observation about information flow rather than a specific buy or sell recommendation.
